items.title: Iran launches more strikes after accusing US of striking near nuclear plant
items.description: Centcom says it hit 90 Iranian targets in the latest round of strikes, with the Iranian health ministry saying 14 people were killed since Tuesday.

items.title: Democrat Graham Platner suspends campaign for key US Senate race after assault allegation
items.description: The decision came days after a woman accused him of sexual assault, an accusation he says is "categorically false".

items.title: Platner's disastrous candidacy exposes rifts that could dampen Democrats' Senate hopes
items.description: Along with creating tumult in a must-win race for Democrats, Graham Platner's exit is laying bare division between the party's left wing and moderates.

items.title: It was 'love at first sight' with their adopted baby. Then they were told he may have been trafficked
items.description: When they adopted Marcus, David and Ally's dream of having a child was complete - but now they could lose him.

items.title: Watch: We're a step closer to finding out if bees have feelings, here's why
items.description: New research found bumblebees showed "emotion-like behaviours" previously only seen in mammals.

items.title: International court tells BBC of breakthrough in Sudan war crimes probe
items.description: The ICC has been looking into atrocities committed in Darfur over the past three years.

items.title: Ukraine to get licence to produce Patriot missiles, Trump says
items.description: Although the Patriots are highly effective against Russia's ballistic missiles, they also have lengthy production times.
